readerCopy.body: The next chapter may begin with a responsibility rather than an exciting announcement. Saturn trine the North Node can make a deadline, commitment, contract, title, boundary, or long-term obligation useful because it gives the future plan something solid to organize around. Decide what you are willing to be responsible for and build from there. A path becomes easier to follow once the terms stop changing.
